faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we start.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: A landing page takes about a week; a full website 2–4 weeks depending on scope. You'll get a clear timeline before we start.

items.question: Do I get to edit the site myself?
items.answer: Yes. I build on a CMS dashboard so you can update text, images, projects and pricing anytime — no code needed.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope. The pricing above is a starting point; send a brief and you'll get an exact quote within 24 hours.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Every project includes a support window, and I offer ongoing care plans if you'd like help long‑term.
